title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: mechanical
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Mechanical plant delivery and lifting to the roof and plant rooms
swms.task: Receive air handling units, chillers and cooling tower sections lifted by the tower crane to the roof and plant room levels, then move them into position on skates and pallet jacks and set them on their plinths.

facts.craneCompany: Lifts are done by the crane company under its lift plan; the crane company's dogman slings and releases loads, and our licensed dogman receives and lands them with tag lines.
facts.loadLimits: Plant is landed only on the plinths and landing zones, and moved only along the routes, marked on the structural engineer's drawing S-501 (10 kPa), checked by the structural engineer before the first lift.
facts.fallControl: Plant is received only inside the perimeter screens and at the crane landing platform with gates closed; no one works at an open edge.

steps: Plan lifts with the crane company
Work with the crane crew during lifts
Receive plant and move it into position

swms.title: Ductwork, pipework and fan coil units at height
swms.task: Install ductwork, chilled water pipework and fan coil units in the apartment ceilings, corridors and risers, drilling into the post-tensioned slabs for hanger anchors, working from scissor lifts and platform ladders more than 2 m above the floor.

facts.fallControl: Risers are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened, and scissor lifts with guardrails are used for work above 2 m.
facts.silicaControls: Anchor holes are drilled with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Use an elevating work platform
Install ductwork, pipework and units at height

swms.title: Refrigerant pipework brazing and nitrogen pressure testing
swms.task: Install and braze refrigerant pipework between the condensing units on the roof and the fan coil units in the apartments, running through the risers, then pressure test the refrigerant pipework with oxygen-free nitrogen.

facts.hotWorkPermit: The principal contractor issues a hot work permit each day; a fire extinguisher is kept at each brazing location and the area is checked after brazing ends.
facts.pressureTesting: Oxygen-free nitrogen through a regulator with a relief valve, tested to the manufacturer's test pressure below the PS on the unit's plate, with the area barricaded and signed during the test, and pressure released through the gauge set before any fitting is touched.
facts.fallControl: Risers are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened, and the roof work is done inside the roof edge protection.

steps: Braze and solder pipe joints (hot work)
Braze refrigerant pipework
Pressure test with nitrogen
missing: Hot work permit and fire watch

swms.title: Roof plant installation
swms.task: Install condensing units, exhaust fans and ductwork on the roof, including brazing connections, next to the roof edge.

facts.fallControl: Edge protection is installed around the roof perimeter before plant is installed, and no one works outside it.
facts.hotWorkPermit: The principal contractor issues a hot work permit each day, with a fire extinguisher at each work area.

steps: Braze and solder pipe joints (hot work)
Braze refrigerant pipework
Install plant and equipment on the roof
missing: Hot work permit and fire watch

swms.title: Basement car park jet fans and exhaust
swms.task: Install jet fans and car park exhaust ductwork in the 3 basement levels, drilling into the slabs for hanger anchors, working from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor, while other trades' vehicles use the car park.

facts.fallControl: Scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m.
facts.silicaControls: Anchor holes are drilled with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn while drilling. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.

steps: Use an elevating work platform
Install ductwork, pipework and units at height
Install car park fans over traffic areas

swms.title: Ductwork and pipework insulation
swms.task: Insulate the ductwork and chilled water pipework with glasswool and foam lagging using adhesives, in the ceilings, risers and plant rooms, from platform ladders.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the glasswool, foam lagging and contact adhesive are kept at the work area: use with ventilation, keep away from ignition sources, wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.fallControl: Risers are screened at each level with only the section being worked on opened and fenced, and work above 2 m is done from scissor lifts with guardrails.

steps: Use an elevating work platform
Insulate ductwork and pipework

swms.title: Refrigerant charging, commissioning and air balancing
swms.task: Evacuate and charge the systems with refrigerant, commission the air handling units, fan coil units and exhaust fans, and balance the air flows.

facts.plantIsolation: Each unit is isolated at its local isolator and locked out with personal padlocks, tested by trying to start it, and the building management system is put in manual off for plant under its control.
facts.fallControl: Roof plant is commissioned only inside the roof edge protection, and ceiling units are reached from platform ladders or scissor lifts with guardrails.

steps: Use an elevating work platform
Evacuate, charge and recover refrigerant
Isolate plant before work on it
Commission and balance the system
